Notes from resident stormburst-totem expert -
Twitch^7: https://www.twitch.tv/aer0plane ^xE05030Youtube^7: https://www.youtube.com/@aer0planegaming781 ^x8888FFDiscord^7: https://discord.gg/WRJqCf8syC All POE 1 Resources: https://tinyurl.com/2svbvtzc ___________________________________________________________________________________________________
How does stormburst work? Channelling skill zaps an area. more duration = more overlapping orbs in an area Stormburst of repulsion has more effective damage and speads over a larger area, making it have great clear at the expense of single target at one spot (unless you keep resummoning totems) Normal stormburst skill ramps as it channels, making orbs last longer at 0.4s intervals i.e. 4s skill duration = 10 orbs poppin. This means the build reaches peak damage after 4s of channeling
This skill has B+ to A tier clear with S tier single target.
In summary: single target: normal stormburst clear: repulsion
Playstyle: mapping: cast stormburst of repulsion totems, cast decoy mapping boss: stormburst of repulsion totems, cast decoy + focus + curse + mines under boss (don't detonate, also optional) bossing: cast stormburst totems, cast decoy, curse, focus (procs weapon/shield double damage, crit belt early on, sigil/frostshield) __________________________________________ Damage scaling: 1. duration - quality of storm burst, inc/more duration on tree/gems 2. crit - power charges, crit passives, crit gear, ass mark, flasks, etc. 3. mana - arcane cloak lightning flat 4. focus - double damage (optional) 5. phys - phys based skill, convert to lightning / gain as lightning
Defence scaling: 1. block - minimal block investment for mapping avoidance, makes mapping very comfy (1 block wheel + 1 prefix chance to block on shield) 2. evasion - minimal evasion investment for mapping avoidance (evasion gear + jade flask + evasion flask suffix) Note: combined block + evasion will provide 50% evade/50% block > 75% hit avoidance 3. decoy totem - monsters don't attack you 4. suppress - basic suppress ~50% (can supp cap later on with better gear or with annoint / mageblood quartz / cluster) 5. MoM - mana + hp 6. arcane cloak - 75% up time 7. curse immune - kikazaru (caster catalyst) + pantheon early 8. ailment immune - endgame avoid shock suffix + stormshroud (early on shock/ignite immune charge mastery) 9. endurance charges - 4%phys/ele mit
Flasks Prefixes: increased duration / reduced charges used Suffixes: reduced effect of curses(until you get kika+pantheon) / increased evasion / increased crit / movement speed -- after you become curse immune, can get stun/ignite/etc.
Others: 1. when using stormburst of repulsion, you can replace totems to do more single target from explosions 2.
Order of quality: And also priority of socket with colours in them 1. stormburst main gem - 20% 2. more duration - 10% 3. arcane cloak - 20% 4. stormblast mines - 20% (early bossing - not so important) 5. bane - 20% (if bossing) 6. sigil of power - 20% 7. more duration - 20% (after ashes)
__________________________________________ Useful uniques: 1. singularity 2. valako's sign 3. careful planning 4. foulborn kikazaru 5. soul mantle 6. anathema 7. unnatural instinct 8. watcher's 9. stormshroud 10. mageblood xd
Progression Tips: [lvl 1] mule ranger for momentum is recommended, can get links 3 wisdoms and flasks [lvl 8+] buy faster attacks after brutus (YES YOU CAN BUY IT NOW) [lvl 12] take stormburst quest reward from Nessa [lvl 12+] buy 1 more stormburst gem in case you get non-trans to trans in merc+ lab [LAB] you will quality stormburst gem in every lab [A5] do league mech in slave pens (maybe have free 5L) [A6] do league mech in twilight strand (maybe have free 5L) [A6] remember to buy haste here [A6] you can start levelling gems for stormburst swap in maps i.e. lightning pen etc. (not mandatory) [Merc lab+] quality stormburst unless you get non-trans to trans outcome [end of campaign] campaign 19 respecs after campaign (0 gold required or 1-2k gold if you don't want to do tidal island) [end of campaign] stormburst gem swaps (regex below) [mapping] can buy a 1c early +1 lightning/phys weapon, shield or amy to shore up damage [mapping] don't forget to aim for life + mana on every piece of gear possible PLEASE [mapping] if you're finding yourself paper, can path to sanctuary on tree for block and buy a %chance to block shield [mapping] save up for singularity (BIG damage) [mapping] careful planning solves alot of dex issues [bossing soul mantle swap] soul mantle + foulborn kikazaru (17% caster catalyst for 70% reduced eff of curses) + yugul pantheon (30% reduced eff of curses) + self-flag [remove phy to lightning] good glove with open prefix to craft phys convert to lightning. change lightning mastery to 40% converted to lightning. (or watchers 40% lightning convert)
Transitions: 1. 6L eva/es 2. lvl 75+ transition to crit 3a. glove with suppress life mana and crafted phys converted to lightning 3b. take 40% phys converted to lightning mastery 3c. switch phys to lightning support to stronger support gem either inspiration/infused channeling/etc. 4. ashes swap 5. corrupted chest implicit swap (for bossing) 6. suppression capping (more for tanky variant -- for bossing variant, probably after mageblood)
